itemalchemy-expansion.config.title: Item Alchemy Expansion Config
itemalchemy-expansion.config.experimenta: The following features are experimental and disabled by default. Enabling them may change EMC calculation behavior. Use with caution.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.nbtMode.too:
FULL: distinguish by all NBT (max compatibility, any mod's NBT variants are distinguished).
SMART: only keep important keys (better performance but may miss unknown mods).
itemalchemy-expansion.config.displayMode:
How items are shown in the Alchemy Table extract slots.
Icon only / Name only / Icon + Name (default).
itemalchemy-expansion.config.searchByTra: When enabled, the search box matches the item's translated name in addition to its ID.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.renderNameU: When enabled (and Display Mode is ICON_AND_NAME), draws a small name label under each extract slot.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.shulkerBoxM:
Allow: shulker boxes can be placed in the Alchemy Table (contents counted as EMC).
Disable: shulker boxes cannot be placed.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.shulkerNoEm:
Reject: reject placing a shulker box if any item inside has no EMC value.
Allow as zero: treat no-EMC items as 0 and allow placing.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.builtInShul: When ShulkerBoxTooltip mod is not installed, show a built-in Shift-hover preview of shulker box contents.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.debugLoggin: Enable verbose INFO logs for variant key generation, extract slot rebuild, register/remove operations. Useful for diagnosing compatibility issues. Turn off for normal play.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.fullIgnoreD: When enabled (FULL mode only), Damage and RepairCost NBT keys are ignored so tools with different durability don't create hundreds of variants. Turn off for strict full-NBT distinction.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.smartNbtKey: Additional NBT keys to include in SMART mode fingerprints (on top of built-in rules). One key per line.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.ignoreNbtKe: NBT keys to always exclude from fingerprints, in both SMART and FULL modes. One key per line.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.perModRules: Per-mod rules (perModRules) can be edited directly in config/itemalchemy-expansion.json5. GUI editing for maps is not yet available.
itemalchemy-expansion.shulker_box.no_emc: Cannot place shulker box: it contains %s which has no EMC value. Switch the 'No-EMC Item Policy' to 'ALLOW_AS_ZERO' in config to ignore.
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.title: Set Item EMC Value
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.scope.glob: Writes to global config, affects all saves
Writes to variant-keyed store, only effective when Precise Mode is on (same ID + different NBT can have separate prices)
Writes to ID-keyed store (default behavior, all same-ID items share one price)
itemalchemy-expansion.set_emc.fail.excep: An error occurred while setting EMC, check logs
itemalchemy-expansion.config.searchShulk: When enabled, searching also checks inside shulker boxes for matching items. Matching shulker boxes appear after direct items, with a small badge of the first match in the slot's bottom-right.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.shulkerMatc: When Shift-previewing a shulker box, draw a red frame around content slots that match the search term. Focus white frame takes priority (a slot that is both focus and match shows only white).
itemalchemy-expansion.filter_button.tool:
Filter mode: click to cycle
All: direct items + shulker boxes
Items: only direct items
Box: only shulker boxes
itemalchemy-expansion.config.preciseMode: Experimental. EMC is queried by item variant (itemId + NBT fingerprint): items with same ID but different NBT can have separate prices (e.g. tacz ammo with different AmmoId). When off, 'same ID = same price' (default behavior). Enabling 'Recipe Auto-Pricing' will automatically enable this.
itemalchemy-expansion.config.autoPricing: Experimental. Scans all recipes registered with the vanilla recipe manager (including custom mod types like TACZ ammo workbench) and prices items with no EMC by summing material EMC. Manual EMC always takes priority over auto. Enabling this will also enable 'Precise Mode' and show a 'Reprice' dialog once.

Experimental. Strategy when multiple recipes produce the same variant. Min: cheapest recipe (recommended, anti-arbitrage); Max: most expensive; Avg: average of all; First: first found. Currently only Min is implemented.
Experimental. When enabled, vanilla/upstream default EMC values are not overridden by auto-pricing. Strongly recommended to keep enabled.
Added 'Recipe Auto-Pricing' and 'Precise Mode' (experimental, disabled by default).
Enable them in Mod Menu -> Item Alchemy Expansion -> Experimental.
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.title: Re-price Already-Set Items?
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.desc: You have manually set EMC for the following items in this save:
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.hint: Choosing 'Yes' will immediately recompute and sync to all online players.
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.hint2: You can run /itemalchemy-expansion reprice later to trigger again.
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.feedback.d: [IAExp] Re-priced %s candidate items and recomputed auto-pricing.
itemalchemy-expansion.reprice.feedback.k: [IAExp] Kept your settings; auto-pricing will only handle undefined items.
